status: audited lossless playback representation; Android outcome unverified

derivative.method: FFmpeg 7.1.5 stream-copy MP4 remux; faststart; movie_timescale 48000; normalize only two avcC reserved-bit bytes from 03/01 to FF/E1
derivative.command: ffmpeg -i ORIGINAL -map 0:v:0 -map 0:a:0 -c copy -movflags +faststart -movie_timescale 48000 OUTPUT.mp4; then normalize the two avcC reserved-bit bytes

verification.timingCaveat: Equality is the FFmpeg interpretation of original and derivative. It is not proof of the failing Android runtime interpretation.
